items.title: Elias (26) måt­te flyt­te ut i telt: – Du må gjø­re det som kre­ves
items.excerpt: Plutselig fikk Elias tilbudet han ikke kunne si «nei» til. Da flyttet han like så godt ut i marka.

items.title: Nabo plages av sjenerende lys fra butikken: – Viser rullerende reklame hele døgnet
items.excerpt: En nabo ble plaget av lyset fra Powers reklameskjerm. Nå sier butikken at de tar naboen på alvor.

items.title: Anne Lise er et av få unntak – fotballtopp blir flau av tallene
items.excerpt: «Flaut» og «brutalt». Slik beskrives tallene som avslører mannsdominansen i norsk toppfotball. Samtidig er Anne Lise Olsen trener for Bryne – en klubb som skiller seg ut.

items.title: Viking-treneren om Glimt-bråket: – Har ikke forstyrret oss
items.excerpt: Viking-trener Bjarte Lunde Aarsheim sier trenerbråket i Bodø ikke har påvirket forberedelsene til Mesterliga-kampen mot Sabah FC – hvor Viking blir regnet som favoritter.

items.title: Warsaw Modlin airport resumes operations after bomb threat reported on London flight – Europe live
items.excerpt: Part of the airport where the flight from Heathrow was parked remain closed Back to Poland, Warsaw Modlin airport says it has resumed operations after an earlier bomb threat – but a part of the airport where the London flight was parked remain closed and is being checked by security forces. items.title: US strikes Iranian island ahead of midterm elections
items.excerpt: US officials described the attacks on Qeshm Island as limited and defensive, according to CBS, the BBC's US partner.

items.title: UK food supply chain affected by European freezer hacks, cyber chief says
items.excerpt: Supermarkets in countries including Ireland, Sweden and Belgium reported fridges being hiked in temperature on Monday.

items.title: Asian Cup postponed due to Middle East conflict
items.excerpt: The Asian Cup has become the latest sporting event to be affected by the ongoing conflict in the Middle East. Organizers cite "exceptional circumstances" in Saudi Arabia, which has seen several Houthi attacks of late.

items.title: How India pulled 500 million people out of poverty, as inequality deepens
items.excerpt: India's extreme poverty has declined from 27.1 percent to 2.6 percent between 2011 and 2023, according to the World Bank.

items.title: McTominay returns as Penrice earns first Scotland call
items.excerpt: Scott McTominay, Kieran Tierney and Che Adams return to the Scotland squad, while there is a first call for James Penrice for the remaining Nations League matches against North Macedonia and Switzerland.
